newsitem.title: USA: J. Baker Jan same-store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: J. Baker Jan same-store sales rise.

text.p: J. Baker Inc said sales for the four weeks ended February 1, 1997 were $43 million compared with $41 million for the four weeks ended February 3, 1996, with same-store sales rising 6.3 percent.
Sales reported last year for the month ended February 3, 1996 totaled $52 million as the fiscal month of January, 1996 was comprised of five weeks.
Sales for the year ended February 1, 1997 were $897 million, less than the the $1.02 billion for the year ended February 3, 1996.

The company said the full-year sales fell mainly due to the closing of s 357 Fayva shoe stores in the third quarter. Sales in the Fayva division accounted for $106 million in the comparable year-to-date period the prior year.
